title: Accountable assurance owner and deputy
objective: A named individual is accountable for the security and assurance program, with a named deputy
risk_addressed: Program drifts or stalls without accountable ownership
frameworks: TSC CC1.3; FTC Safeguards 314.4(a); CSF GV.RR; ISO 42001 5.3
implementation_mechanism: Owner designation recorded in policy model; appointment event
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Written policy set approved and versioned
objective: Policies POL-01..13 are approved by the approval authority, versioned, and generated from the structured policy model
risk_addressed: Policies absent, stale, or diverging between versions in use
frameworks: TSC CC5.3; CSF GV.PO; FTC Safeguards 314.4; ISO 27001 5.2
implementation_mechanism: F# policy model in protected repository; approval recorded as signed commit by approval authority; published hash
independence_requirement: Approval by authority other than drafter
failure_response: Unapproved policy not published; drift raises alert
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Unauthorized policy change detection
objective: Published policy and control definitions always match an approved version
risk_addressed: Silent weakening of policy or controls (by human or agent)
implementation_mechanism: CODEOWNERS/rulesets on policy repo require approval authority; published-hash vs approved-hash comparison; weakening-change classifier flags diffs that lower thresholds or remove controls
independence_requirement: Classifier is advisory; human approval decisive
failure_response: Restore approved version; incident if bypass
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Risk assessment and risk register
objective: Risks to objectives (security, privacy, financial integrity, fraud, AI, vendor, regulatory, assurance-system) are assessed and treated
frameworks: TSC CC3.1-CC3.4; FTC Safeguards 314.4(b); CSF GV.RM, ID.RA; ISO 42001 6.1
implementation_mechanism: Machine-readable risk register; review event; agents propose emerging risks, humans decide treatment
independence_requirement: Treatment decisions by owner; reviewed externally
failure_response: Overdue review escalates to approval authority
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Requirement register and applicability decisions
objective: Every obligation is recorded with applicability classification, reasoning and mapped controls; undetermined items routed to qualified advisers
implementation_mechanism: regulatory/requirements.csv + validator; open-question register
independence_requirement: Applicability judgments confirmed by counsel/CPA where undetermined
failure_response: CI fails on unmapped or dangling requirements
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Regulatory change monitoring
objective: Changes to authoritative sources are detected and assessed against affected requirements, controls and policies
implementation_mechanism: Agent monitors source register URLs/feeds, opens review items with diff; human disposition
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Exception and risk acceptance register
objective: Exceptions are recorded with scope, compensating control, expiry, requester and an independent approver; agents cannot approve
frameworks: TSC CC5.1; NIST AI RMF GOVERN
implementation_mechanism: Tutela-style exception engine: verified non-self approver, expiry, role check; expiry auto-converts to control failure
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Authority matrix enforced by systems
objective: Approval authorities are defined once (machine-readable) and consumed by repository rules and application authorization

implementation_mechanism: Authority matrix in policy model compiled into rulesets, Ordo/Tutela roles, Unbound authorization
independence_requirement: Matrix changes approved by approval authority
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Segregation of duties (humans and agents)

risk_addressed: Single actor implements, validates and approves; fraud; error
frameworks: TSC CC5.1; NIST AI RMF MEASURE 1.3
implementation_mechanism: SoD matrix enforced: reviewer ≠ author, approver ≠ initiator, validator ≠ control operator; periodic role-combination analysis
exception_handling: Owner decision DF-ASR-2026-0D04: routine low-risk work proceeds under standing human authorization with a separate implementing agent, a technical verifier and an enforced release gate; material policy, privilege, financial-exception and verifier changes need elevated human approval; fractional human review where required. Technical independence is not organizational independence.
known_limitations: With one or two people, full SoD is impossible; compensating controls and external review must carry weight (OQ-607/608)

title: Management review of assurance metrics
objective: Control health, failures, exceptions, risks, incidents and regulatory changes are reviewed and decisions recorded

implementation_mechanism: Agent-prepared review pack from registers and evidence; human review and decisions recorded
independence_requirement: Pack prepared by agent; decisions human
